subject: springboot
question: What does the spring-boot-docker-compose module do in Spring Boot 3.1+?
options: Starts services from a compose file on startup and creates service connections to them
Builds a Docker image during mvn package
Generates a compose file from your beans
Deploys the app to Docker Swarm
explanation: During development it runs docker compose up and auto-configures connection details for recognised containers.

subject: springboot
question: Which location takes precedence if both define the same property: classpath:application.properties or classpath:config/application.properties?
options: classpath:application.properties
classpath:config/application.properties
Neither; startup fails on a conflict
Whichever file was modified most recently
explanation: Spring Boot loads the classpath root first and then classpath:/config/, so the later config/ location overrides it.

subject: springboot
question: What does the @JsonTest slice set up?
options: An embedded HTTP server for JSON endpoints
Jackson serialization support, including JacksonTester, without the full context
Contract tests for JSON schemas
A JSON-based in-memory database
explanation: @JsonTest auto-configures the ObjectMapper and JSON testers so you can test serialization in isolation.

subject: springboot
question: How can /actuator/info show the build version and artifact from Maven?
options: Annotate the main class with @BuildInfo
Set management.info.version=true only
Run the spring-boot-maven-plugin build-info goal to generate META-INF/build-info.properties
Expose the /actuator/build endpoint
explanation: When build-info.properties is present, Spring Boot auto-configures a BuildProperties bean used by the info endpoint.

subject: springboot
question: What isolation level does @Transactional use when none is specified?
options: SERIALIZABLE
REPEATABLE_READ in all databases
READ_UNCOMMITTED
Isolation.DEFAULT, meaning the underlying datastore's default
explanation: Isolation.DEFAULT defers to the database, for example READ COMMITTED on PostgreSQL.

subject: springboot
question: How do Spring Data repository methods support pagination?
options: Adding LIMIT manually to the method name
Accepting a Pageable parameter and returning Page<T> or Slice<T>
Annotating the method with @Paginate
Returning a Stream and skipping elements
explanation: Passing PageRequest.of(page, size) as a Pageable makes Spring Data apply limit and offset, and Page also includes the total count.

subject: springboot
question: Which annotation binds an HTTP request header to a controller method parameter?
options: @RequestHeader
@RequestParam
@CookieValue
@RequestAttribute
explanation: @RequestHeader("X-Request-Id") reads that header value and can convert it to the parameter type.

subject: springboot
question: What does @ConditionalOnBean(CacheManager.class) on a @Bean method do?
options: Registers the bean only if a CacheManager bean is already defined
Creates a CacheManager if none exists
Makes the bean depend on CacheManager's lifecycle
Registers the bean only if the CacheManager class is on the classpath
explanation: @ConditionalOnBean checks the bean definitions registered so far, which is why it is mainly used in auto-configurations with careful ordering.

subject: springboot
question: Which database migration tools does Spring Boot auto-configure when found on the classpath?
options: Flyway and Liquibase
DbUnit and Testcontainers
Ant and Gradle
Hibernate Envers and jOOQ
explanation: Spring Boot runs Flyway or Liquibase migrations at startup when their libraries are present.

subject: springboot
question: Since Spring Boot 2.6, what happens by default when two beans depend on each other in a cycle?
options: Spring resolves the cycle silently with proxies
Startup fails because circular references are prohibited by default
The second bean is injected as null
Spring retries creation until it succeeds
explanation: spring.main.allow-circular-references defaults to false, so cycles cause a startup failure unless you opt back in.
